scripts.text:
[Guide]
This castle has a hidden secret.
That is the ^4d4dff'Okolnir'^000000.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
這座城堡隱藏著一個秘密。
那就是^4d4dff“奧科爾尼爾”^000000。

scripts.text: About Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 關於奧科爾尼爾

scripts.text: Go to Okolnir.
scripts.translation: 前往奧科爾尼爾

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Okolnir is a kind of virtual realm...
I don't know how Okolnir exists, but I guess only Valkyrie knows.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
奧科爾尼爾是一種虛擬領域...
我不知道奧科爾尼爾是如何存在的，但我想只有瓦爾基里知道。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
As you know this is a place to test the adventurers made by Valkyrie...
...you know the qualifications to enter Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
如您所知，這裡是瓦爾基里用來考驗冒險者的地方...
...您應該知道進入奧科爾尼爾的條件。

scripts.text: Qualifications?
scripts.translation: 條件？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Yes, Valkyrie definitely prefers strong adventurers.
Only the qualified can enter Okolnir and Valhalla.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
是的，瓦爾基里肯定更青睞強大的冒險者。
只有符合條件的人才能進入奧科爾尼爾和瓦爾哈拉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It only opens when everyone comes together to work it out.
The key is in the castle.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
它只在大家齊心協力時才會開啟。
鑰匙就在城堡裡。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
If a castle's ^4d4dffeconomy is over 65 and defense also over 30^000000, this will be acceptable to access Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
如果城堡的^4d4dff經濟超過65且防禦超過30^000000，就可以滿足進入奧科爾尼爾的條件。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
And, if you pass all of the tests given by Valkyrie in Okolnir!
You will also receive a mysterious gift.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
而且，如果您通過了瓦爾基里在奧科爾尼爾中給出的所有考驗！
您還將獲得一份神秘的禮物。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Would you like to try to enter here?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
您想嘗試進入這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Great! Economy and Defense are OK.
You can enter Okolnir now....
Do you want to go there?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
太好了！經濟和防禦都達標了。
您現在可以進入奧科爾尼爾了....
您想去那裡嗎？

scripts.text: Sure let's go there.
scripts.translation: 好的，我們走吧。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Ok......
Please follow me...

[Guide]
You can try this anytime in the future...
If you are ready to protect this castle.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
您以後隨時都可以嘗試...
如果您準備好守護這座城堡的話。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You are not qualified yet.
Please develop your castle more...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
您目前還不符合條件。
請繼續發展您的城堡...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... OK...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
...好的...
祝您好運。

scripts.text: Enter now.
scripts.translation: 現在進入

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hope you get everything you want...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
希望您能如願以償...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Really?
Sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
真的嗎？
聽到這個訊息我很遺憾。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Building Okolnir needs quite a long time.
....even though it's only virtual...
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
建造奧科爾尼需要相當長的時間。
...儘管它只是虛擬的...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
It takes about 12 - 13 hours to create the virtual realm.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
建立這個虛擬領域大約需要12到13個小時。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
You'll have to wait.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你得等待。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
... I've never seen you before.
You are strangers here. You'd better get out of here right now.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
...我從未見過你。
你是這裡的陌生人。你最好現在就離開。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I am... Wish maiden.
Mourning in this virtual realm, Okolnir.
On behalf of the humanbeings who defeated God here.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我是...許願少女。
在這個虛擬領域奧科爾尼中哀悼。
代表那些在此擊敗神明的凡人。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Are you ready to endure the trials to get the Goddess' glory?
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你準備好承受試煉，以獲取女神的光輝了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I am
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了

scripts.text: Sorry, I'll try later
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我稍後再來

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will test whether or not you deserve the Goddess shine...
Isn't it simple?
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我將測試你是否配得上女神的光輝...
這很簡單，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Okolnir is a virtual place.
There is no room for error there.
^ff0000You only have one hour.^000000
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
奧科爾尼是一個虛擬的地方。
那裡沒有容錯的空間。
^ff0000你只有一小時的時間。^000000

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
If you have not finished in that time, Okolnir will be destroyed, and I will go to rest.
You will have to wait again...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
如果你沒有在規定時間內完成，奧科爾尼將被摧毀，我也將安息。
你將不得不重新等待...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Are you ready to go through?
^4d4dffYou need to have 16 to 20 members present^000000.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你準備好通過了嗎？
^4d4dff你需要有16到20名成員在場^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will open the gate of Okolnir if your members are ready.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
如果你的成員準備好了，我將開啟奧科爾尼的大門。

scripts.text: We are ready.
scripts.translation: 我們準備好了。

scripts.text: We need more time.
scripts.translation: 我們需要更多時間。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Now I will open the gate of Okolnir where I am.
I will wait for you on the top of Okolnir...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
現在我將開啟奧科爾尼的大門。
我會在奧科爾尼的頂端等你...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I hope that you can complete all of the trials before the virtual Okolnir is destroyed...
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我希望你能在虛擬的奧科爾尼被摧毀之前完成所有試煉...
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You need to have 16 to 20 members present to open the gate of Okolnir.
Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你需要有16到20名成員在場才能開啟奧科爾尼的大門。
準備好後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Don't hesitate to try.
You should catch the chance when it comes to you.
Just gather your fellow members.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
不要猶豫去嘗試。
當機會來臨時，你應該抓住它。
只需召集你的同伴成員。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
... Are you afraid of
the trials facing you?
....
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
...你害怕
面前等待你的試煉嗎？
....

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Do you think that you can defeat the Goddess shine easily?
I feel disappointed by all of you.
Just go away...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你以為能輕易擊敗女神的光輝嗎？
我對你們所有人感到失望。
請離開...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Do you wish to enter?
Only those prepared may enter here.
You must bring several items to enter Okolnir.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你希望進入嗎？
只有做好準備的人才能進入這裡。
你必須攜帶若干物品才能進入奧科爾尼。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Dusk Glow
Dawn Essence
Cold Moonlight
Hazy Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
黃昏的光芒
黎明的露珠
冰冷的月光
陰暗的星光。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Goddess Tear
Valkyrie's Token
Brynhild Armor Piece
Hero Remains
Valkyrie Armor
Andvari's Ring.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
女神的眼淚
瓦爾基里的象徵
布倫希爾德的鎧甲碎片
英雄的遺骸
瓦爾基里鎧甲
安德巴里的戒指。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Please bring those four things, 10 Agate, 10 Rose Quartz, and 20 Elunium,
a Heavenly Maiden's Robe, as well as 100 Soft feathers.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
請攜帶那四樣東西、10個瑪瑙、10個玫瑰石英、20個鋁，
一件天女長袍，以及100根軟羽。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You must bring those six things, 10 Gold, and 20 Elunium.
Many Valhala's Flowers are also required as an offering.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你必須攜帶那六樣東西、10個金幣和20個鋁。
還需要許多巴哈拉的花作為祭品。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Once all of those are prepared, the gate will open.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
當所有這些都準備就緒時，大門將會開啟。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
.... 
...........The Goddess shines brightly down on you, you should be stronger to deserve it...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
.... 
...........女神的光輝照耀著你，你應該變得更強以配得上它...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Remember...
You need to collect many soft feathers.
I hope that your dreams come true.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
記住...
你需要收集許多軟羽。
我希望你的夢想成真。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will answer all your requests if you bring these to me.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
如果你把這些帶給我，我會滿足你所有的請求。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I am... Wish maiden.
Mourning in this virtual realm, Okolnir.
On behalf of the humanbeings who defeated God here.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我是...許願少女。
在這個虛擬領域奧科爾尼中哀悼。
代表那些在此擊敗神明的凡人。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Bring me the one who brought you to this place.
.. Deliver him to my will.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
把帶你來到此地的人交給我。
.. 將他交付於我的意志。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
...You are not qualified.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
...你不符合資格。

scripts.text: There are too many people, you can't enter.
scripts.translation: 人太多了，無法進入。

scripts.text: The Warp Gate responds to the Crystal Key.
scripts.translation: 傳送門響應水晶鑰匙。

scripts.text: You need the Crystal Key to activate the Warp Gate.
scripts.translation: 你需要水晶鑰匙來啟用傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
As I declared, I will give the Goddess' shine to you.
You have the requirements to carry it...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
正如我所宣佈的，我將把女神的光輝賜予你。
你具備承載它的資格...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
You will be granted the power of the great Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你將獲得偉大的瓦爾基里的力量...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will give you some things for fun.
All of you enjoy them together...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我會給你們一些好玩的東西。
大家一起享受吧...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Go to Rachel and Juno to meet the Ravies sisters.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
去拉赫和朱諾見見拉維姐妹。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
I will open the gate for you to come back here.
...Okolnir won't last forever...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
我會為你開啟大門讓你回來。
...奧科爾尼不會永遠存在...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
As I declared, you are worthy of holding the {0}.
However, you do not have the requirements on you...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
正如我所宣佈的，你有資格持有{0}。
然而，你並不具備相應的條件...

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
...Did you forget something?
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
...你忘了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
All of you worked together as a team...
Humans are strong when they are united, but are easily swayed by lust.
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
你們所有人都是作為一個團隊共同奮鬥的...
人類團結起來時是強大的，但很容易被慾望所左右。

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Humans are imperfect, so their chief god is there for them when they need help.
....
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
人類是不完美的，所以當他們需要幫助時，他們的主神會守護他們。
....

scripts.text:
[Wish Maiden]
Always be real.
Do not regret your actions...
scripts.translation:
[許願少女]
永遠保持真實。
不要後悔你的行為...
